criteria.description: All core scientific claims, equations, and baseline comparison numbers provide verifiable citations (IEEE/ACM/ArXiv DOI, standard RFC, or hardware vendor datasheet); cite document citations.
Experimental conditions, benchmark suites, test parameters, and hardware/software environments are explicitly documented for reproducibility; cite setup descriptions.
Metrics, trade-off curves, and comparative evaluation tables reflect balanced, unbiased analysis without suppressing trade-offs or cherry-picking scenarios; cite analysis sections.
Architectural specifications and design documents adhere to the stated functional interface limits and external system dependencies; cite specification constraints.
